title: First time? The Navigator offers its 60-second tour once
items: On a device's first landing, Home offers "First time? Take the 60-second tour" under its three choices. Taking it starts the Field Check in the town; going in any other way declines it, and it is not offered again.
After it, three short hints show once each: at your first Jaunt's first stop, after your first Jump to another year, and on the first Reconstructed building you open.
No hint shows while the Field Check is running, and each goes at your next move or after a few seconds.
